mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) triggers restrictive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100,000 jobs per month.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month industrial production decline below 108.0 (index) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 108.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in quarterly GDP growth and housing starts indicates economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint weakness in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS > 0.5% MoM) signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.
